Koegaki 1.13.9

  • This release is for the Mac. Windows stays on 1.15.2 and Linux on 1.15.1.
  • On the Mac, the first download of the speech model keeps trying through an outage, picks up where it stopped, and has a second source to fall back on.
  • On the Mac, Koegaki never asks you to relaunch it. When it needs a fresh start, it restarts itself with one button.
  • On the Mac, updates can arrive early on Macs that opt into early releases.

Koegaki 1.13.8

  • This release is for the Mac. Windows stays on 1.15.2 and Linux on 1.15.1.
  • On the Mac, updates now install by themselves even when Koegaki runs into trouble. An update that is waiting installs as soon as Koegaki opens, and if Koegaki ever quits on its own twice within an hour, it repairs itself by installing the newest version and tells you so.
  • On the Mac, Check for Updates is safe to choose at any time: it waits until its menu has closed and can no longer close Koegaki.
  • On the Mac, a dictation now pastes reliably even when your Mac is under heavy load.

Koegaki 1.13.7

  • This release is for the Mac. Windows stays on 1.15.2 and Linux on 1.15.1.
  • On the Mac, Koegaki no longer quits by itself after a dictation, after Check for Updates, or when you close its window.
